from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.red_days_required = 3

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if symbol in data.Bars:
                bar = data.Bars[symbol]

                if symbol == self.spy:
                    self.spy_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

                elif symbol == self.aapl:
                    if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                        if bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                        else:
                            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

                    self.aapl_rsi.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
                    self.previous_aapl_close = bar.Close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            if self.spy in data.Bars:
                self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
                if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                    self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            return

        if not all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            if self.spy in data.Bars:
                self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
                if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                    self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        aapl_sell_reason = (
            self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        )

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and spy_crossed_above
        ):
            quantity = int(
                math.floor(
                    0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_close
                )
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= self.red_days_required
            and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
        ):
            quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma

                else:

            return

            and current_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        aapl_sell = (
            current_aapl_rsi is not None
            and current_aapl_rsi > 60
        )

        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and aapl_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_buy:
            price = current_spy_close
            target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
            shares = int(target_value / price)

            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.spy_lot = shares

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 1:
            price = current_aapl_close
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 / price)

                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.aapl_lot = shares

        self._update_previous_values(
            current_spy_close,
            current_spy_sma,
            current_aapl_close,
            current_aapl_rsi
        )

    def _update_previous_values(
        self,
        spy_close,
        spy_sma,
        aapl_close,
        aapl_rsi
    ):
        if spy_close is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close

        if spy_sma is not None:
            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma

        if aapl_close is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if aapl_rsi is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_rsi = aapl_rsi
